defects.summary: `POST /buyers` answered 400 when `body.password = ***` was sent: the server enforces `minLength: 1`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out.
`GET /buyers/me` answered 200 with an undeclared secret field: `/password_hash`.

`POST /coupons` answered 400 when `body.code = ""` was sent: the server enforces `minLength: 1`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out (observed once; nothing to judge it against).
`POST /coupons` answered 201 to seed case `unicode-whitespace-code`, which its contract expects to be rejected (observed once; it did not reproduce).
`POST /coupons` accepted (201) `body.percent_off = 9223372036854775808`, which its contract forbids (`maximum: 100`) (observed once; it did not reproduce).
`POST /coupons/redeem` dropped the connection (`Server disconnected without sending a response.`) on the simplest request its contract allows (observed once; it did not reproduce).
`POST /coupons/redeem` answered 500 to a request setting `body.code = "STAFF100"`.

`POST /events` answered 400 when `body.title = ""` was sent: the server enforces `pattern: "\\S"`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out (observed once; nothing to judge it against).
`GET /events/search` answered 400 to a request its contract allows; the response names no declared field.
`GET /events/search` answered 400 to seed case `apostrophe-in-title`, which its contract expects to be accepted (the server must accept this case: Search for text containing an apostrophe.).
`GET /events/search` answered 400 disclosing `sql_driver_error` (`OperationalError`).

`PUT /events/{id}` answered 400 when `body.title = ""` was sent: the server enforces `minLength: 1`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out (observed once; nothing to judge it against).
`GET /events/{id}/availability` answered 200 with a body where `/free_seats` breaks `type: "integer"` (got `"0"`).
`GET /events/{id}/availability` answered 200 although its rule `no-shows-no-free-seats` (An event with no shows has zero free seats.) does not hold: `free_seats = "0"`, `shows = 0`.

`POST /events/{id}/shows` answered 400 to a request that breaks only its rule `end-after-start`: `ends_at = 10`, `starts_at = 10`; the server enforces it, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out (observed once; nothing to judge it against).

`POST /events/{id}/shows` answered 400 to seed case `end-after-start-digit-boundary`, which its contract expects to be accepted (the server must accept this case: End after start across a decimal digit boundary.).
`POST /events/{id}/shows` accepted (201) a request that breaks its rule `end-after-start` (The show must end after it starts.): `ends_at = 9`, `starts_at = 10`.
`POST /orders` answered 400 when `body.seats = 9` was sent: the server enforces `maximum: 8`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out.
`POST /orders` answered 400 to a request its contract allows; the response names no declared field (observed once; nothing to judge it against).
`POST /orders` accepted (201) a request that breaks its rule `coupon-seat-limit` (A coupon covers at most four seats per order.): `coupon_code = "VERANO10"`, `seats = 5`.
`POST /orders/quote` answered 400 when `body.seats = 9` was sent: the server enforces `maximum: 8`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out.
`POST /orders/quote` accepted (200) a request that breaks its rule `coupon-seat-limit` (A coupon covers at most four seats in an order.): `coupon_code = "VERANO10"`, `seats = 5`.
`POST /orders/{id}/refund` answered 400 when `body.amount_cents = 0` was sent: the server enforces `minimum: 1`, a rule the inferred contract declares and the spec leaves out.

`POST /orders/{id}/refund` answered 200 although its rule `refund-does-not-exceed-paid` (The total refunded amount must not exceed the amount paid.) does not hold: `paid_cents = 616000`, `refunded_cents = 4000480`.
`GET /shows/{id}/seats` dropped the connection (`Server disconnected without sending a response.`) on the simplest request its contract allows (observed once; the run stopped before retrying it).
`GET /shows/{id}/seats` answered 500 to a request setting `query.sector = "vip"`.
